If you’re looking for the best bang for your buck, here’s how our options shake out:

Essentials Medium – $159, up to 21 lbs (6 cuts)
Same core cuts as Signature (ground beef, chicken breasts, pork chops, seafood, prepared items), just no specialty cuts like ribeye, filet, or scallops. Lowest cost per box while still getting premium meat.

Signature Medium – $179, up to 21 lbs (6 cuts)
Includes everything Essentials offers plus 30+ specialty cuts (ribeye, filet mignon, scallops). Slightly higher price, but access to premium cuts can make the value feel higher if you like special-occasion meats.

Both plans include:

Free shipping
Access to member deals and add-ons (often big savings on extra meat)
Flexible subscription management and member perks (rewards, recipes, loyalty benefits)

If you mainly want maximum volume and savings on everyday proteins, the Essentials Medium is your best value sweet spot.
If you care about premium steaks/seafood for just a bit more, the Signature Medium is the best bang for your buck.
